The two succeeded staging runs (e1b32af8 and its predecessor) stay walk_id null under the new guard: walk 6350cb8b has no sweep, so even a backfilled link reads STAGING_SIBLING_NO_SWEEP. A fresh staging publish with the inline sweep walk (or verify-walk --publish-run=e1b32af8 on the new image) is required before Bastrop production.

PRODUCTION_SITE_URL is not pinned in the build file: the production facets route (`/api/spine/cortex/api/brokerage/v1/place/node/<id>/facets` under the production Smart Site base) has not been probed live by this lane; canon shows smartsite.cloud serving `/api/spine/property-atoms/{id}/facets`, a different route. Sweep cost: LANDING_SITUS_SQL pulls four situs columns for every landing row of the county (77,799 for Bastrop; Travis is larger); one scan, selection in JS so the rule lives in one place. Within the walk job's 1Gi/900s; state the environment if a larger county proves otherwise.
